Outside of my schooling, I am very interested in fashion and see it as art! I love how personal style allows people to express themselves through clothing, colors, and textures. I especially enjoy thrifting and upcycling clothes, finding unique pieces, and giving them a new life through my own creative ideas. I have worked on several personal projects that allow me to experiment with different styles and further explore fashion. Here are a few of my projects that I have worked on.
